test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Identify the correctly spelt sentence.**

options.text: Celastial objects are not visible to the naked eye.
Kelestial objects are not visible to the naked eye.
Celesteal objects are not visible to the naked eye.
Celestial objects are not visible to the naked eye.

solution: The correct answer is **"****Celestial objects are not visible to the naked eye."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Celestial"** means of the sky or of heaven. (आकाश या स्‍वर्ग से संबंधित) • Example:* The moon is a **celestial**__ body.* • The sentence conveys that the unaided eye cannot see objects in the sky. • Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 1ef:T6f5,
